Description: Diffusion interaction parameter from DLS; proxy for net protein-protein interactions in dilute solution.

AC‑SINS spectral shift (Δλmax) relative to buffer/control; larger positive shifts indicate higher self‑interaction.
Notes / Source: AC‑SINS = affinity‑capture self‑interaction nanoparticle spectroscopy; Δλmax ≥ 15 nm is commonly used as a high self‑interaction flag.

Description: Full width at half maximum of the main SEC/SE-UHPLC monomer peak (peak broadening).

Retention time on heparin chromatography column.
Notes / Source: Heparin chromatography is commonly used as a proxy for charge-driven nonspecific interactions.

Description: %B buffer at elution in heparin chromatography.

Description: Area under the concentration-time curve to the last sampled timepoint (systemic exposure after IV dosing); stored as AUC0–672h/104.
Notes / Source: Higher AUCt generally corresponds to slower clearance. Divide stored values by 100 to express AUCt in the 106 ng·h/mL units used in the manuscript and figures.

Description: Accelerated stability (AS) SEC slope: long-term stability slope calculated from % aggregated measured by SEC during a 30‑day incubation at 40 °C.
Notes / Source: Defined in Jain et al. as “AS SEC slope” computed from % aggregated (SEC) vs time during accelerated stability testing.
Higher values indicate increased polyspecific interactions.
